v01-restaurant-360.name: Restaurant 360
tags: ★ since 2018 · Michelin Plate before that · seasonal — opens 27 March 2026
EUR 230–280 menu (pairing +120)
Essential — book 2–3 months ahead, weekend dinners go first
Dinner; sunset from the wall arches
v01-restaurant-360.why: ★ since 2018 · Michelin Plate before that · seasonal — opens 27 March 2026. To order: the tasting menu only — Chef Marijo Curić's Adriatic-meets-Asia line, ~10 courses. Built into the arches above the Old Port — service is exposed to the sea, dinners stop when Jugo blows hard. Closed Nov–March.
v01-restaurant-360.hours: Dinner; sunset from the wall arches
v01-restaurant-360._lane: The grand tables — on the walls, the roof and the sea

v02-stara-lo-a-prijeko-palace.name: Stara Loža (Prijeko Palace)
tags: Michelin Guide listed continuously since 2017
EUR 80–140 pp
Book the 16-seat rooftop 3+ weeks ahead
Dinner, rooftop
v02-stara-lo-a-prijeko-palace.why: Michelin Guide listed continuously since 2017. To order: the chef's day-market menu; oysters from Mali Ston when in season; sea bass in salt crust. Three spaces stacked vertically — street terrace, 3rd-floor salon, 16-seat rooftop. The one Prijeko Street address that is not a trap.
v02-stara-lo-a-prijeko-palace._lane: The grand tables — on the walls, the roof and the sea

v04-nautika.name: Nautika
tags: Set in the former Nautical School (1881); on the city's classic-luxury short list
EUR 120–180 pp
Essential for the sea-side terrace; 2+ weeks
Dinner at sunset — Bokar and Lovrijenac frame the view
v04-nautika.why: Set in the former Nautical School (1881); on the city's classic-luxury short list. To order: lobster bisque · whole turbot for two · soufflé glacé Grand Marnier. The conservative anniversary dinner. Chef Mario Bunda. No experimentation; the room is the experience.
v04-nautika.hours: Dinner at sunset — Bokar and Lovrijenac frame the view
v04-nautika._lane: The grand tables — on the walls, the roof and the sea

v03-proto-fish-restaurant.name: Proto Fish Restaurant
tags: Founded 1886 — oldest operating fish house in Dubrovnik · Michelin Guide recommended
EUR 70–110 pp
Book 1 week ahead for the terrace
Lunch on the terrace; dinner indoors
v03-proto-fish-restaurant.why: Founded 1886 — oldest operating fish house in Dubrovnik · Michelin Guide recommended. To order: king prawns alla buzara · Ston oysters · grilled sea bass on the bone · crni rižot. Edward VIII dined here in 1936 with Wallis Simpson on the way to Lokrum — the Esculap group runs it now without breaking the recipe book.
v03-proto-fish-restaurant.hours: Lunch on the terrace; dinner indoors
v03-proto-fish-restaurant._lane: The old houses inside the walls

v05-kopun.name: Kopun
tags: Michelin Plate · Marin Držić's 16th-c. capon recipe revived
EUR 45–70 pp
Book 5–7 days for the square terrace beside St Ignatius
Dinner — the square lights at dusk
v05-kopun.why: Michelin Plate · Marin Držić's 16th-c. capon recipe revived. To order: kopun (slow-roasted capon with oranges & honey, the Držić recipe) · šporki makaruli · arancini for dessert. The dishes you cannot order elsewhere. Beside the Boškovićeva (Jesuit) Stairs of Game of Thrones Walk-of-Shame fame.
v05-kopun.hours: Dinner — the square lights at dusk
v05-kopun._lane: The old houses inside the walls

v11-lady-pi-pi.name: Lady Pi-Pi
tags: Cult Old Town grill — no reservations, queue from 17:00
EUR 25–40 pp
Walk-in only — queue starts forming at 17:00
Early dinner before the queue, or 21:30+
v11-lady-pi-pi.why: Cult Old Town grill — no reservations, queue from 17:00. To order: mixed grill platter · grilled squid · house sausages · the lemon-and-oil potatoes. Open charcoal in the corner — you eat on a vine-covered terrace within the walls. Cash welcome; cards yes but slow.
v11-lady-pi-pi.hours: Early dinner before the queue, or 21:30+
v11-lady-pi-pi._lane: The old houses inside the walls

v06-konoba-dubrava.name: Konoba Dubrava
tags: The reference peka above the city — order 3 h ahead
EUR 35–55 pp
Call by 14:00 for an evening peka; 11:00 for lunch
Lunch with the Old Town view; sunset from the terrace
v06-konoba-dubrava.why: The reference peka above the city — order 3 h ahead. To order: lamb peka (3 h pre-order) · veal peka · octopus peka · house-made bread. The bell over embers, the right way: salt, rosemary, olive oil, time. Big-sky views down to Lokrum and across the islands.
v06-konoba-dubrava.address: Bosanka 5, 20207 Dubrovnik (10 min by car above Old Town)
v06-konoba-dubrava.hours: Lunch with the Old Town view; sunset from the terrace
v06-konoba-dubrava._lane: Under the bell — the country konobas

v09-konoba-konavoski-dvori.name: Konoba Konavoski Dvori
tags: Restored old watermill on the Ljuta — Esculap group · in the Michelin Guide
EUR 45–65 pp
Book 1 week for weekend lunches
Lunch — the cold river runs through the dining room
v09-konoba-konavoski-dvori.why: Restored old watermill on the Ljuta — Esculap group · in the Michelin Guide. To order: žaba na brodet (frog brodet) · river trout · lamb peka · asparagus in season. Waitstaff in traditional Konavle dress. The frog brodet is one of the dishes you cannot get in the city. The river is the air conditioning.
v09-konoba-konavoski-dvori.address: Ljuta bb, 20210 Cavtat (Konavle, 35 min south of Dubrovnik)
v09-konoba-konavoski-dvori.hours: Lunch — the cold river runs through the dining room
v09-konoba-konavoski-dvori._lane: Under the bell — the country konobas

v07-bota-are-mali-ston.name: Bota Šare Mali Ston
tags: On-quay oyster bar; runs its own boat trip from the dock
EUR 40–70 pp
Walk-in possible at lunch; book dinner Apr–Sep
Lunch, then a boat run across the bay to the oyster beds
v07-bota-are-mali-ston.why: On-quay oyster bar; runs its own boat trip from the dock. To order: 12 Mali Ston oysters with lemon and Pošip · oyster tempura · sea-bass crudo · mussels na buzaru. The PDO Ostrea edulis at one hour and zero kilometres from the boat. Bring your own bottle of Korčula Pošip if you prefer; corkage is friendly.
v07-bota-are-mali-ston.address: Mali Ston bb, 20230 Ston (15th-c. salt warehouse)
v07-bota-are-mali-ston.hours: Lunch, then a boat run across the bay to the oyster beds
v07-bota-are-mali-ston._lane: Mali Ston — the oysters at the source

v08-vila-koruna.name: Vila Koruna
tags: One of the original Mali Ston oyster houses — operating since 1973
EUR 35–55 pp
Walk-in fine outside high summer
Lunch off-season; early dinner in summer
v08-vila-koruna.why: One of the original Mali Ston oyster houses — operating since 1973. To order: oysters au naturel · mussels na buzaru · octopus salad · grilled scampi. Less polished than Bota Šare, more honest. Rooms above the restaurant if a Pelješac stay is the plan.
v08-vila-koruna.hours: Lunch off-season; early dinner in summer
v08-vila-koruna._lane: Mali Ston — the oysters at the source
